title: Travel questions answered
description: Answers about guide prices, inclusions, departure requests, solo travel, WhatsApp, payments, and cancellation terms.

copy.original: Useful details for the first stages of planning. Confirm arrangements in your written quote.
copy.value: Useful details for the first stages of planning. Confirm arrangements in your written quote.

copy.original: Choose a journey, request your preferred dates, and send an enquiry by WhatsApp or email. The team must confirm availability, the total price, and final terms in writing before any booking or payment.
copy.value: Choose a journey, request your preferred dates, and send an enquiry by WhatsApp or email. The team must confirm availability, the total price, and final terms in writing before any booking or payment.

copy.original: They are owner-authorised guide prices for planning, not live inventory or a promise of availability. The final quote must confirm dates, occupancy, transport, meals, activities, taxes, and supplements.
copy.value: They are owner-authorised guide prices for planning, not live inventory or a promise of availability. The final quote must confirm dates, occupancy, transport, meals, activities, taxes, and supplements.

copy.original: Each trip has a proposed inclusion list and an exclusion list. Most overnight proposals cover stays, breakfast and dinner, and agreed route transport. Flights, insurance, lunches, and optional activities are generally separate. Only your accepted quote determines the actual package.
copy.value: Each trip has a proposed inclusion list and an exclusion list. Most overnight proposals cover stays, breakfast and dinner, and agreed route transport. Flights, insurance, lunches, and optional activities are generally separate. Only your accepted quote determines the actual package.

copy.original: You can request a place on a proposed group journey. Room sharing, group size, departure viability, hosting, and any single supplement must be confirmed first. Women-only proposals also depend on confirmed staffing and a viable departure.
copy.value: You can request a place on a proposed group journey. Room sharing, group size, departure viability, hosting, and any single supplement must be confirmed first. Women-only proposals also depend on confirmed staffing and a viable departure.

copy.original: No fixed departures or seat counts have been supplied yet. Request a future date and the team will check whether a group departure or a private alternative can be arranged.
copy.value: No fixed departures or seat counts have been supplied yet. Request a future date and the team will check whether a group departure or a private alternative can be arranged.

copy.original: The enquiry flow supports custom itineraries and preferences. Request a revised proposal for different stays, more rest days, private transport, or a combined regional route.
copy.value: The enquiry flow supports custom itineraries and preferences. Request a revised proposal for different stays, more rest days, private transport, or a combined regional route.

copy.original: Final business-approved payment, cancellation, and refund conditions are still required. The policy pages identify the missing terms. Agree the final conditions before paying.
copy.value: Final business-approved payment, cancellation, and refund conditions are still required. The policy pages identify the missing terms. Agree the final conditions before paying.

copy.original: Yes. The owner supplied +91 99062 69900 as the business WhatsApp number. Review your enquiry, open WhatsApp, and press Send yourself.
copy.value: Yes. The owner supplied +91 99062 69900 as the business WhatsApp number. Review your enquiry, open WhatsApp, and press Send yourself.

copy.original: A place in mind? A feeling to follow?
copy.value: A place in mind? A feeling to follow?

copy.original: Tell us your dates, your people, and what you’d love to experience.
copy.value: Tell us your dates, your people, and what you’d love to experience.
